spec_gap.summary: F01 has no authoritative classifier input and risk contract, mixed-signal precedence, exact class projection and optional-Interview routing semantics, hash and override contract, or executable gold/underprocessing acceptance oracle.
spec_gap.not_fail_reason: No in-scope implementation was attempted because an implementation would have to invent the scientific process-depth policy and its own acceptance oracle.
spec_gap.not_blocked_reason: No external tool, credential, licensed source, host capability, or backend is missing; the missing authority is a shared product contract.

sub_contract_gaps.subject: classifier input and authority
sub_contract_gaps.missing_contract: A typed request-feature and risk vocabulary, the authority relationship between the provider-nondeterministic LLM proposal and a deterministic Kernel guard, and an exact mapping from request and policy artifacts to those inputs.

sub_contract_gaps.subject: mixed-signal precedence and underprocessing floor
sub_contract_gaps.missing_contract: Deterministic precedence and tie-break rules for causal, high-stakes, expensive, ambiguous, open-novelty, mechanism, synthesis, lookup, and transform signals, including monotonic no-downgrade rules.

sub_contract_gaps.subject: class projection, routing, identity, and override
sub_contract_gaps.missing_contract: Exact E0-E5 required_phases, default_role_count, human_gate_required, conditional Interview routing, ID and timestamp generation, canonical classification_hash preimage, retry semantics, and the immutable override artifact boundary.

sub_contract_gaps.subject: acceptance oracle and authorized test surface
sub_contract_gaps.missing_contract: Canonical gold fixtures, expected labels and projections, metric and PASS threshold, fail-closed adversarial cases, and exact write authority for the required tests or fixtures.
